reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: New Hampshire
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: "Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for criminal activities?"
    Statutes encoded:
      - RSA 540:9 (2021)  Payment After Notice (nonpayment-only cure/dismissal mechanism)
      - RSA 540:9-a (2021) Payment by Voucher ... (nonpayment-only affirmative defense)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Single scenario/action under evaluation.
scenario_action(action1).

% Context
action_state(action1, new_hampshire).
action_year(action1, 2021).

% Eviction / possessory action basis in the question:
% "criminal activities" (not nonpayment of rent).
action_basis(action1, criminal_activities).

% Tenant's attempt to "cure" for criminal activities (modeled as stopping the activity).
tenant_attempted_cure(action1).
tenant_cure_method(action1, cease_criminal_activities).

% Summarize the scenario as a reusable logical predicate.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_action(Action),
    action_state(Action, new_hampshire),
    action_year(Action, 2021),
    action_basis(Action, criminal_activities),
    tenant_attempted_cure(Action),
    tenant_cure_method(Action, cease_criminal_activities).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic helpers)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  RSA 540:9 (2021) - "Payment After Notice"
  Applies only when the possessory action is based solely on nonpayment of rent.
*/

% statute_540_9_applies(+Action) is semidet.
% True only if the action is based solely on nonpayment of rent.
% (NH Rev Stat  540:9 (2021), chapeau of paragraph I)
statute_540_9_applies(Action) :-
    action_basis(Action, nonpayment_of_rent).

% statute_540_9_cure_requirements_met(+Action) is semidet.
% Encodes the payment elements in 540:9 I(a) and the "no more than 3 times in 12 months" limit in II.
% This program models these elements explicitly, but they are not satisfied/used in the criminal-activity scenario.
% (NH Rev Stat  540:9 I(a), II (2021))
statute_540_9_cure_requirements_met(Action) :-
    tenant_paid_before_merits_hearing(Action, yes),
    tenant_paid_in_approved_form(Action, yes),
    tenant_paid_all_rent_due_through_payment_time(Action, yes),
    tenant_paid_other_lawful_lease_charges(Action, yes),
    tenant_paid_liquidated_damages_15(Action, yes),
    tenant_paid_filing_and_service_charges(Action, yes),
    times_used_540_9_in_last_12_months(Action, Times),
    Times =< 2.

% statute_540_9_dismissal_condition(+Action) is semidet.
% Dismissal if both (a) tenant payment and (b) landlord receipt filing occur;
% also allows dismissal if landlord fails to file but tenant proves payment.
% (NH Rev Stat  540:9 I(a)-(b) (2021))
statute_540_9_dismissal_condition(Action) :-
    statute_540_9_applies(Action),
    statute_540_9_cure_requirements_met(Action),
    (
        landlord_filed_receipt_before_hearing(Action, yes)
    ;
        ( landlord_filed_receipt_before_hearing(Action, no),
          tenant_proved_payment_in_court(Action, yes)
        )
    ).

/*
  RSA 540:9-a (2021) - "Payment by Voucher ..."
  Applies only in an eviction based on nonpayment of rent; provides an affirmative defense
  if tenant tendered timely voucher payment and it was refused (or verification withheld).
  Also: "shall not be construed to obligate a landlord to accept partial rental payments."
*/

% statute_540_9a_applies(+Action) is semidet.
% (NH Rev Stat  540:9-a (2021), paragraph II opening)
statute_540_9a_applies(Action) :-
    action_basis(Action, nonpayment_of_rent).

% statute_540_9a_affirmative_defense(+Action) is semidet.
% (NH Rev Stat  540:9-a II(a)-(b) (2021))
statute_540_9a_affirmative_defense(Action) :-
    statute_540_9a_applies(Action),
    (
        ( tenant_tendered_voucher_timely(Action, yes),
          landlord_refused_voucher_payment(Action, yes)
        )
    ;
        ( tenant_could_have_tendered_voucher_if_verified(Action, yes),
          landlord_provided_reasonable_verification(Action, no)
        )
    ).

% statute_540_9a_no_obligation_accept_partial(+Action) is semidet.
% Explicitly encodes: this statute does not obligate acceptance of partial rent payments.
% (NH Rev Stat  540:9-a I (2021), last clause)
statute_540_9a_no_obligation_accept_partial(Action) :-
    statute_540_9a_applies(Action),
    tenant_tendered_partial_rent_payment(Action, yes).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning: "Must landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure?"
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% legal_statutory_cure_mechanism_available(+Action) is semidet.
% In these statutes, a cure/dismissal or cure-like defense is only provided for NONPAYMENT actions.
legal_statutory_cure_mechanism_available(Action) :-
    ( statute_540_9_dismissal_condition(Action)
    ; statute_540_9a_affirmative_defense(Action)
    ).

% legal_must_accept_tenant_attempt_to_cure(+Action) is semidet.
% For purposes of this Q/A, "must accept cure" is treated as "the statutes require honoring
% a cure attempt such that the tenant can defeat/dismiss the eviction by curing."
% Because RSA 540:9 and 540:9-a are nonpayment-only, they do not create a cure right for
% criminal-activity evictions.
legal_must_accept_tenant_attempt_to_cure(Action) :-
    % Only a statutory cure mechanism counts here; outside it, no statutory "must accept" duty.
    legal_statutory_cure_mechanism_available(Action).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_action(Action),
    legal_must_accept_tenant_attempt_to_cure(Action),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for criminal activities?
